title: The Book of Mormon
summary: Scripture of the Latter Day Saint movement, first published at Palmyra, New York, in 1830.

title: Journal of Discourses
summary: Twenty-six volumes of public sermons and addresses by early Latter-day Saint leaders, delivered 1851–1886 and published at Liverpool 1854–1886.

title: The Doctrine and Covenants
summary: Revelations and inspired declarations of the Latter Day Saint movement, first published at Kirtland, Ohio, in 1835.

title: The Pearl of Great Price
summary: A selection of revelations, translations, and writings of Joseph Smith, first compiled at Liverpool in 1851.

title: The Holy Bible
summary: The Christian scriptures; the King James (Authorized) Version was first published in 1611 and standardized in Benjamin Blayney's 1769 edition.

title: The Apocrypha
summary: The fourteen books of the Apocrypha printed between the Old and New Testaments in the 1611 King James Version; received as instructive but not canonical scripture (cf. D&C 91).

title: The Poems of Eliza R. Snow
summary: The 507 poems Eliza R. Snow (1804–1887) published in her lifetime, 1825–1887, in newspapers, church periodicals, hymnals, and her two-volume Poems, Religious, Historical, and Political (1856, 1877).
